subject: Engineer Outreach — sticky CTA rotation & asset bundles
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Micah Dunn <micah@cloudkernel.io>
Cc: marketing-ops@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Engineer Outreach — sticky CTA rotation & asset bundles

Team / Micah — quick kickoff note for the inbound webinar nurture we discussed (hands-on: LLM serving patterns for product engineers). Key asks below; aim is a lightweight rotation that increases RSVP lift for engineers without spamming.

High-level plan (attach: segment_matrix.csv, cta_variants_v3.png, tracking_links_utm.xlsx):
- Microsegments: Core engineers (backend infra), ML infra leads, platform engineers (internal tools). See segmentation matrix.
- CTA rotation: Test three sticky CTAs that persist in the footer and second module of the email. We want a primary CTA (Register), secondary (Watch micro-demo), tertiary (Join office hours). Rotate based on persona; sticky CTA should change on reminder #2.
- Cadence: Day 0 invite, Day 4 reminder, Day 10 last chance; short SMS-style copy on reminders for engineers.
- Tracking: UTM pattern = ?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=eng-outreach-v1&utm_content={cta_variant}_{segment}

Micah — can CloudKernel confirm co-sponsor logo + sponsor blurb by EOD Tuesday (2027-06-01)? We want to include a logo block and sponsor-specific CTA that links to your landing page.

Connor / Marissa — please propose 2 subject lines and 3 body variants per segment. Ben — can you run estimated send-capacity (ESP quotas) for cadence and flag any warmup concerns?

Thanks — kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, Field Marketing | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cta_variants_v3.png (image/png), segment_matrix.csv (text/csv), tracking_links_utm.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Draft copy variants (short-form, tailored to each microsegment). Paste into an email template and we can A/B on subject + preheader.

1) Core engineers — Invite (variant A)
Subject: Hands-on LLM serving patterns — practical tricks you can deploy
Preheader: Short 45-minute session + live Q&A with runtime experts
Body (snippet): Engineers — join a hands-on walkthrough of latency and cost tradeoffs for serving large models. We’ll demo batching patterns and KV curb strategies you can adapt today. Register now (primary CTA).

2) ML infra leads — Invite (variant B)
Subject: Design patterns for production LLM inference (tech checklist)
Preheader: Architecture patterns, cost controls, and rollout guardrails
Body (snippet): For infra leads: we’ll cover kernel selection heuristics, quantization tradeoffs, and autoscaling policies that preserve SLAs. Watch the micro-demo (primary CTA) or register for the full session.

3) Platform engineers — Invite (variant C)
Subject: Faster LLM inference for product teams — real examples
Preheader: See code snippets, deployment configs, and heuristics
Body (snippet): Practical examples for product-focused platform teams — integrations, API patterns, and observability hooks. Join office hours for hands-on debugging after the session.

Reminder copy (short):
- Reminder #1 (Day 3): "Seats filling fast — register for the hands-on LLM serving session" + one-line bullet of topics.
- Reminder #2 (Day 8): "Last chance to register — limited seats" + sponsor CTA (Micah's landing page).

UTM mapping examples (from tracking_links_utm.xlsx):
- Primary CTA: utm_content=ctaA_core
- Reminder CTA: utm_content=ctaC_mlinfra

I'll upload the 3 HTML modules (desktop + mobile snippets) to Drive and drop the link in the sheet.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole

Thanks all — quick status and next steps: 
- Micah: noted — we’ll use the CloudKernel landing + your UTM. Please drop assets into the Drive folder by EOD 6/1.
- Marissa: please finalize the three HTML modules and push to the Drive by 6/2 so ops can QA.
- Connor: adjust cadence to 0 / 3 / 8 and add preheader tests.
- Ben: confirm ESP capacity and TLS/DKIM checks by 6/2; if anything blocks send we’ll shift the schedule by one day.

Final routing rules for sticky CTAs (ops):
- If recipient segment == core_engineers -> module A + CTA variant A persistent in footer and 2nd module.
- If recipient segment == ml_infra -> module B + CTA variant B primary, swap to Register on reminder #2.
- If recipient segment == platform -> module C + office-hours CTA as tertiary.

I'll create the HubSpot list based on segment_matrix.csv and share the list id in the Drive. If we hit any deliverability flags, loop security (cc: security@redwood.com) but hope that won't be necessary.

If all thumbs up, we should start sends on 2027-06-07 (tentative).

Kim
